notes: Not verified: whether any in-scope path in the native engine needs a second animation frame (water/lava are world-block animations handled by the mesher, not by TextureAtlasSprite here). The atlas.json dump consumed by csrc/engine/render_blocks.c and raster_particles.c carries minU/maxU/minV/maxV exactly as the Java fields ended up. The animation (lane/skytex): test_rendertick rebuilds MeshProbe's atlas dump byte for byte from anim.rgba at its recorded state and steps the counters between frame rows exactly; the frame views anim_liquids_f* match their goldens with no pxdiff cluster. lane/idxclient: the sprite's layout members are closed as data: the stitched atlas is the oracle's dump, read bit for bit (rb_atlas_load); the animation is texanim.c's; mip and anisotropic paths are off in every oracle run.
